title: Concept: Conda channel list relies on `defaults`
description: .condarc declares a channel list that still contains `defaults`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a channel list that still contains `defaults`.
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a channel list that still contains `defaults`.
